title: CoRP implies BPP under complementation
statement: Let $E$ be a verifier model whose efficient verifiers are closed under Boolean negation, and let $L$ be a language of bit strings. If the complement of $L$ has an $E$-efficient randomized verifier with polynomially bounded randomness, acceptance probability at least $2/3$ on members, and rejection probability exactly $1$ on nonmembers, then $L$ has an $E$-efficient randomized verifier with both correctness probabilities at least $2/3$.
